{{- $core := resources.Get "ext/core.js" | minify -}} {{- $shell := resources.Get "overlay.js" | minify -}} {{- $js := printf "(()=>{%s\n%s\nrenderStats(gatherStats());})()" $core.Content $shell.Content -}} {{- $js = replace $js "%" "%25" -}} {{- $js = replace $js "&" "%26" -}} {{- $js = replace $js "\"" "%22" -}} {{- $js = replace $js "#" "%23" -}} {{- $js = replace $js "+" "%2B" -}} {{- $js = replace $js "'" "%27" -}} {{- $js = replace $js "<" "%3C" -}} {{- $js = replace $js "\n" "%0A" -}} Page DOM Stats
